messages:
tom: Heads-up: eu-central firewall change `fw-policy-audit-v5` just rolled and we're seeing ~80 GPUs in the warm pool fail to complete onboarding. Nodes stuck at `waiting-for-kms` with egress denied to the HSM proxy and audit endpoints.

priya: Confirmed from the console. Provisioner logs show repeated `connect: egress denied` to `hsm-proxy.internal:443` and `audit-collector.internal:5044`. KMS grants return 403 intermittently.

devops-bot: deploy/fw-policy fw-policy-audit-v5 applied by infra-cd at 2024-06-12T08:33Z :white_check_mark:

priya: Log sample:
```
2024-06-12T08:35:02Z ERROR network egress denied dst=audit-collector.internal:5044 rule=deny-unapproved-egress
2024-06-12T08:35:08Z WARN kms grant fetch failed status=403 svc=hsm-proxy
2024-06-12T08:35:22Z INFO warmpool join attempt=5/10
```

tom: Quick mitigation options: 1) ephemeral allowlist for the two FQDNs in the region policy, 2) route audit/hsm traffic via dedicated NAT (cost), 3) rollback the policy in eu-central.

secops: Policy was tightened intentionally for L7 inspection. Ephemeral allowlists are allowed for emergency onboarding but must be recorded with justification and expire within 2 hours. Please include `sec-justification` tag in the PR and file an incident ticket.

billing: Quick cost estimate: NAT egress to finish onboarding (80 GPUs, ~7k requests/min) ~ $320/hr for eu-central. If we allowlist, cost ~0 but security exposure window needs to be documented.

priya: Proposed plan: create ephemeral allowlist for `hsm-proxy.internal` and `audit-collector.internal`, run a 10-node canary, verify `keystore.kms_error_rate` falls to baseline, then open more nodes. Add max window 90m.

tom: I'll open PR with ipset entries + `temp_allow_reason` and runbook reference: `runbooks/provisioning/fw-ephemeral-exception.md`. PR draft: https://redwood.internal/infra/pulls/2042

sre-oncall: Oncall here. Rerouting new onboarding to us-west-2 for the next 60m to reduce customer impact. Setting alert: `gpu.warmpool.join_rate < 0.6 for 10m` and watch `keystore.kms_error_rate`.

secops: When PR merges, add a single-line audit entry to the central audit index and post justification to the security board channel. We'll require a post-action review within 48h.

priya: Adding smoke script `scripts/check-audit-and-hsm.sh` to the PR. It will `curl -v https://audit-collector.internal:5044/health` and `openssl s_client -connect hsm-proxy.internal:443 -brief` as checks.

billing: If we choose NAT instead of allowlist, I'll need a spend cap in the PR.

tom: Merged draft with tags and smoke test. Kicking canary now. Will update with results.

priya: Canary 10 nodes joined successfully. `keystore.kms_error_rate` back to baseline. Proceeding to scale to full warm pool in waves of 20.

secops: Exception logged and approval ticket created: SECB-442. Post-action: include findings in the infra monthly audit.

priya: Full warm pool recovered. Closing this thread for timeline. Will create a short postmortem linking to SECB-442 and the PR.

tom: Thanks everyone — keeping notes for the PM and compliance review. :thumbsup:
